injuries.detail: Washington (illness/shoulder) is listed as out for Saturday's game against the Clippers.
Lawal (groin) is out for Saturday's game against the Clippers.
Head coach Dusty May said Friday that Lively (foot) is moving well and progressing in his recovery, and the big man told May he's "close" to returning, Mike Cur
De Larrea (knee) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.
Biberovic (heel) is out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.
Ingram (Achilles) is expected to make his season and team debut Monday against the Rockets, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.
Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.
